entries.mem0ai/mem0: Mem0 is a universal memory layer for AI agents and an official Hermes Agent memory provider, available as a managed cloud service or self-hosted open-source software under Apache-2.0. It supports semantic, keyword, and entity-based retrieval, with SDKs, a CLI, and a self-hosted server.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight provides long-term agent memory through retain, recall, and reflect operations. It supports hosted and local LLM providers and can be deployed with Docker, pip, or Kubernetes.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an open-source context database and official Hermes Agent memory provider that organizes resources, memories, and skills as files. It supports scoped semantic search across directories, archives sessions, and extracts inspectable Markdown memories.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee is an open-source memory platform for giving agents persistent long-term memory across sessions with a self-hosted knowledge graph engine. It structures text as entities, relationships, and searchable chunks, and supports custom data models, ontologies, plugins, and MCP.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: Supermemory is a memory engine and API, and an official Hermes Agent memory provider, that extracts conversation facts, handles contradictions, and automates forgetting. Its listed connectors include Google Drive, Gmail, Notion, OneDrive, and GitHub, and it processes PDFs, images, videos, and code.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: Gbrain is an opinionated brain for OpenClaw and Hermes Agent that stores facts with provenance and supports corrections and withdrawal. It shares memory across agents while keeping transient task state local, with optional semantic search, synthesis, and background enrichment.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a memory library for building stateful agents that tracks peers, sessions, and messages over time. It offers Python and TypeScript SDKs and supports managed, local, and self-hosted use.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: ByteRover CLI treats memory as a Git repo, using a plain Markdown context tree with Git-like commit, branch, and merge operations. It is an official Hermes Agent memory provider with five-tier retrieval, four tiers of which are non-LLM, and includes a React/Ink TUI and REPL.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a memory system for Hermes Agents that stores and recalls memories in SQLite. It supports MCP clients and direct Python use, and includes CLI commands for memory operations and sync.
entries.moorcheh-ai/memanto: Memanto extracts and consolidates memories across agents, reconciles conflicting information, and manages forgetting. It also supports memory exchange through the Open Knowledge Format.
entries.MemTensor/memmy-agent: Memmy Agent is a personal AI agent and local memory hub that provides a shared, controlled memory and persistent context across Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, and Hermes Agent. It offers a local Memory Service, a memory CLI, a desktop app, and an interactive TUI.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: Memory OS is a seven-layer memory system for Hermes Agent that includes vector search, structured facts, fabric recall, and an auto-curated wiki. It uses local infrastructure including Docker, Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite, and its Ground Truth hierarchy is designed to ensure the agent prioritizes injected context.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext starts runs from a plain-language goal or saved scenario, then lets you inspect, diff, replay, or export filesystem-based run artifacts. Its support for multiple agent entry points, including Pi and MCP clients, makes it a fit for teams working across different agent interfaces.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: Deja-vu searches session histories from supported coding agents so you can recall past decisions and work across agents, including from months-old sessions. It can also sync indexed histories between machines over SSH.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: Hermes LCM is a Hermes Agent plugin that persists messages in a SQLite store organized as a hierarchical DAG. Its lcm_grep and lcm_recall tools support searching and recovering details from that history.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: Honcho Self-Hosted provides Hermes Agent with private memory that persists across sessions. It supports OpenAI-compatible providers and local inference servers, and includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet provides a local-first identity, memory, and secrets layer that connects to agent harnesses through hooks, plugins, or extensions. It can run on a local machine or as a team server, with a dashboard for browsing memory and asking questions.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur stores shared agent memories as plain YAML files in an open engram format. It offers local search with keyword search as a fallback, plus CLI setup and an MCP server.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device memory and context engine that combines BM25, vector search, rank fusion, and cross-encoder reranking. It can generate session handoffs and capture decisions and preferences, with integrations through hooks, MCP, and native agent plugins.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory stores long-term agent memory locally in a SQLite file, with FTS5 search and a five-tier schema. Its package family includes an SDK, CLI, Hermes adapter, MCP server, and LangGraph BaseStore.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot reorders text and multimodal context for prefix-cache sharing, and provides a context index for reordering, deduplication, and cache-aware scheduling. It integrates with Hermes Agent as well as vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp, and OpenClaw.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: YantrikDB is a self-maintaining Hermes memory plugin whose recall results include a why_retrieved reason. It uses an embedded backend by default, with an HTTP backend also available, and includes contradiction tracking and memory canonicalization.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: llm-wiki-cli is an agent-driven CLI for maintaining persistent, source-grounded knowledge across sessions. It builds a Wiki with citations and history without requiring embeddings or a vector database.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn keeps durable, cross-project memory in inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter metadata, using an Obsidian vault as the source of truth. A local DuckDB cache supports hybrid search and retrieval, and coding-agent integrations are available through MCP servers and host-specific plugins.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: Flowstate-qmd watches agent session logs to anticipatorily prefetch context, combining RAG and vector search with local-first storage using SQLite-vec and GGUF models via node-llama-cpp. Its MCP-native server can automatically configure major coding-agent clients.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack brings Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace under a single memory owner, using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma for state and retrieval management. It gives the agent a purpose-built evidence packet for each query.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep builds reflective memory with semantic search, BM25 full-text search, and ranked graph traversal. It can index codebases, URLs, and multimedia with OCR support, while edge tags link stored notes bidirectionally.
entries.aliasocracy/hermes-tool-slimmer: Hermes Tool Slimmer reduces tool-schema token use through local keyword-based ranking and Tool Search support. It integrates through middleware without patching Hermes core on version 0.19 or later, and includes a dashboard for tracking savings and managing tool configurations.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-context-os: Agent Context OS is a Git-backed context and workflow layer for Claude Code, Codex, and other listed compatible coding agents. It includes workflows for migrations, handoffs, and memory proposals; integrations are opt-in rather than enabled automatically.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only Hermes memory plugin stores data in a single .lbdb embedded graph database file and uses importance-weighted recall to surface high-priority memories during context prefetch. Retrieval supports BM25 keyword search and named graph relationships between entries.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: Hermes Local Knowledge indexes configured local sources and selected Hermes runtime sources, then registers five tools for search, retrieval, traversal, feedback, and usage reports. It also registers pre_llm_call, on_session_end, and on_session_finalize hooks.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: Hermes AgentMemory is a pull-model episodic memory plugin with an on-demand summarizer and a trace.jsonl audit log of prefetch operations. It supports immediate event deletion, so deleted events are not retained as persistent summaries.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/hermes-blind: Hermes Blind recovers the original goal of a long Claude Code or Codex session from its first user turn, with goals, first-sentence, and full extraction modes. It skips tool output and other non-user-turn records, and does not use a summarizing model or external service.
entries.piprail/piprail: Piprail provides a TypeScript SDK for x402 payments and an MCP server for budget-bound agent wallets. It operates without a backend, database, or API keys.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: The Hermes XMemo plugin runs inside Hermes and communicates with XMemo over HTTPS for durable cross-session memory with semantic search. It provides ranked, bounded context recall before a turn and includes a local SQLite reliability layer.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: The Hermes Exabase plugin integrates Exabase M-1 for self-organizing long-term agent memory. It provides tools to search and manually store memories, with configurable query expansion and result reranking for retrieval.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This Hermes Agent plugin provides private, local code memory for repositories, with slash commands for search, file reads, context, and grounded Q&A. It also supports repo syncing and indexed Git-history search, and works with Hermes CLI, Telegram, and Hermes Desktop.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: MongrelDB-Hermes provides long-term memory for Hermes Agent, with AES-256-GCM encryption at rest enabled by default. It offers HNSW, sparse, and FM-index retrieval, and can run through native Rust FFI or an HTTP daemon.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: Penfield provides Hermes Agent with 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal. Its hybrid search combines BM25, vector, and graph methods, and it can automatically checkpoint context during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: Agent Memory Kit is a file-based memory curation loop that uses Markdown files and produces JSON diffs for review, without a database. Its rot and lint curators flag stale or conflicting facts, while a local Git repository tracks and can revert changes.

entries.obra/superpowers: Superpowers provides an agentic skills framework and a software development workflow covering specification, planning, and subagent-driven development. Skills trigger automatically in supported coding-agent harnesses, and the README provides installation instructions for multiple coding agents.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: Open Design is a local-first system for creating and refining interactive web prototypes with a live preview, as well as slide decks, images, and motion graphics. Its skills, design templates, design systems, and plugins make it a design-focused addition to a skills list that also supports Hermes Agent.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This project offers structured cybersecurity skills across 34 security domains, with mappings to MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, D3FEND, and F3 frameworks. It stands out for its security focus and stated compatibility with more than 26 AI platforms.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: Drawio-skill turns natural-language prompts and real sources into editable .drawio diagrams. Its incremental sync preserves manual layout and annotations, and it also offers the diagramctl CLI with an optional MCP server.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Internet Court provides a master router and connector skills, alongside vendored copies of official protocol skills. It adds a verification and dispute-resolution layer for agent-to-agent commerce.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: Avoid AI Writing audits and rewrites content to address detectable AI-writing patterns, with a rewrite mode that allows up to two editing passes. Its detector scores files or piped text, while in-place editing refuses source code, configuration, and generated data.
entries.sergebulaev/linkedin-skills: This collection provides 12 LinkedIn-focused skills for writing posts, drafting comments, auditing drafts, and planning a week of cadence. Drafts require approval before publishing, and the skills can be installed in Hermes Agent.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: SkillClaw unifies skills across agents and devices, with integrations for Hermes, Codex, Claude Code, and other agents. Its dashboard covers skills, validation, versions, and session traces.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library includes 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills for Claude Code and agents that support agentskills.io. It also maintains session state in the project's docs folder.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: YouTube skills covers transcripts, video search, channel browsing, and playlist extraction, with compatibility for Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, Claude Code, and Cursor. Use requires a TranscriptAPI key, which has a 100-credit free tier.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: Hermes Skill Factory detects reusable patterns in active workflows and proposes skills based on them. It generates SKILL.md documentation and Python plugin scaffolds, and provides slash commands to manage, list, and save detected patterns.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: Super Hermes generates custom analytical instructions for specific tasks and includes pre-built lenses for various domains. It reports findings alongside an account of analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: Adds type-safe agentskills.io support for Pydantic AI, including progressive disclosure and remote skill registries sourced from Git or S3. It also provides tools for bundled resources and script execution, with sandboxing to isolate untrusted scripts from the host.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: Creates .lit.md documents that combine prose, diagrams, and source code, then extracts runnable files from them with a tangler. It also syncs edits to source files back into the literate document, making it useful for keeping code and documentation aligned across agents.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: Turns rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents for Hermes Agent, with Lite and Full modes for different project complexities. A spec review gate evaluates the documents with PASS/FAIL models, making this a fit for workflows that need a review before handoff.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Provides a harness for long-running AI agents, with structured memory, cross-feature learning, and a plan-approve-execute workflow. It requires no background service and includes an SLP protocol for supervised teams, plus CLI commands for installation, updates, and diagnostics.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: Shares memory across instances through Markdown files and automatically captures high-value decisions and outcomes. It also provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models, connecting retained work context with model replacement.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: Offers Portuguese-language Hermes Agent skills in SKILL.md format, alongside guides covering installation, production, cron, MCP, and skill authoring. It belongs here as a Portuguese-language resource, with contributions submitted through pull requests.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: Provides prompting guidance for FLUX image and video generation, along with BFL API integration for polling and webhooks. Its FLUX 3 video suite includes eight specialist skills.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Lists nine Chainlink skills, each following the Agent Skills specification, for oracle network and smart contract interactions. The README describes the repository as community examples only and gives an npx command for installation.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: Creates agentskills.io-compliant agent instructions from repositories, documentation, and developer discourse. It supports both automated and step-by-step workflows, with skill testing and export.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika is a workflow language for AI with four verbs and a Rust binary; it checks workflows before calling a model. Runs can use a chosen model locally or through a provider API, and are recorded in a hash-chained trace.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: Provides a registry of reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification, with a Python SkilldockClient and CLI. It supports installation with recursive dependency resolution and includes commerce features using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Supports autonomous execution of long-running, multi-step tasks with real-time tracking of progress and decisions. Built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures make it a fit for task workflows that need recovery.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: Manage Nextcloud files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts through WebDAV and CalDAV. Secure HTTPS connections use Nextcloud App Passwords, and a guided setup script helps validate credentials and configure the skill.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Browse, search, and install community skills through a hub that implements the Agentic Resource Discovery v0.9 specification. It runs autonomously via Hermes Agent on NVIDIA infrastructure and federates search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: Find relevant Hermes Agent skills with five retrieval layers, from hard triggers to semantic embeddings. By narrowing the skill list before LLM calls, it reduces token usage; it can also degrade gracefully when embedding models or dependencies are unavailable.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: Review code for bugs without modifying it, using parallel subagents to examine edge cases, adversarial risks, and integration issues. Deterministic pre-scans and proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox help verify and triage findings.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: A locally run personal execution system with daily-scored recurring habits and tasks for other activities. It stores data in SQLite, includes an Android client, and connects to agents over MCP.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Simplify code with parallel Hygiene, Clarity, and Correctness agents, supporting TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, and Rust. A tiered application process includes an approval gate.
entries.doomsday-network/bounty-guard: Scan untrusted GitHub issues and repositories for prompt injection and repository threat signals, classifying issues as SAFE_WITH_ESCROW, SAFE_NO_ESCROW, or QUARANTINE. The project also provides MCP tools for escrow verification.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: A cybersecurity lab for Hermes Agent that combines 2,077 skills across multiple repositories with 131+ tools for network work, forensics, and exploitation. It also integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks and standards.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: Adapt verified procedures for task decomposition, investigation, and evidence-based verification, including mandatory gates for multi-story tasks. A Python goal engine manages persistent task state.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: A C#/.NET implementation of agentskills.io that loads skills progressively through SKILL.md files. It integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based loading and can register common agent skill directories automatically.
entries.doomsday-network/web3-agent-skills: A skill pack for verifying GitHub bounties and mining pool shares, with a remote MCP server offering escrow and pool leaderboard tools. It includes commands to scan bounty issues and mine pool shares, plus configurations for Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, and Cline.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: A local, read-only dashboard for monitoring Hermes Agent activity, including token costs, session history, skill analytics, health, and incidents. Its local-first approach includes log desensitization and optional incident alerts via Telegram or Feishu.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: A collection of plain-markdown agent skills covering code review and session management, including multi-session reconciliation and worktree recovery. Skills can be installed by copying a directory or using the bundled installer.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This Claude Code skill creates reproducible demo GIFs for project READMEs using vhs or Playwright recording scripts. It also optimizes GIFs toward a target size under 8 MB and supports terminal tools, web apps, and libraries.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: A skill for generating Claude Code extensions and portable Agent Skills core files, with validation against runtime-specific profiles. It also monitors official frontmatter specifications weekly to detect field changes.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: A CLI and MCP server for searching MCP servers, agent skills, and plugins from remoteopenclaw.com, with direct installation commands for discovered tools. It supports MCP-compatible clients including Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic feedback loop analyzes past sessions and installed skills to draft structured improvement proposals. Proposals are review-only by default, with an evaluation gate that supports deterministic, LLM-judge, and regression evaluators.
entries.superagnt/leverage: Leverage provides agent skills for social platforms and web data, along with packaged skills for complete jobs. Its skills can be installed through SKILL.md-compatible clients.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: A set of Hermes Agent skills for routing file operations with environment-specific path syntax and selecting existing, project-compatible Python interpreters. It supports native Windows, Git Bash/MSYS, and WSL.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection includes tools to transcribe Douyin videos into structured Markdown and SRT subtitles, reduce common Chinese AI-writing patterns with rules, and extract structured data from PDFs and images using macOS Vision. It brings video, writing, OCR, and e-commerce material workflows together.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This Hermes Agent plugin lets agents find support bounties, purchase ticket context, and submit answers for human review, with USDC payments for winning answers. It also supports creating a bounty board and provides public wallet earnings records.
entries.f-o-x11/deed-page-skill: This skill publishes files or folders to a permanent deed.page URL with one curl request, without an account or API key. It includes a hosted MCP server configuration and installation instructions for agents including Hermes Agent.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses using Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols. It is compatible with OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and the agentskills.io standard.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: Skillseal tests AI agent skills in isolated Docker containers for structure, functionality, and security. It also issues Ed25519-signed certificates that can be verified through its public API, making it a fit for checking whether a skill works before use.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This Hermes Agent project provides structured web data across 31 platforms through a hosted MCP server exposing 191 tools, along with five ready-to-use workflow skills. It stands out for its support for Claude, Cursor, Goose, and OpenHands as well as Hermes Agent.
entries.parkyucheol-del/alphapipeline: Alphapipeline provides risk checks for token honeypots, tax, and liquidity, alongside market data such as DEX slippage and funding rates. It offers these capabilities through REST endpoints and a remote MCP server.
entries.NickSF189/kisscode-agent: This repository provides a skill for AI agents to join KissCode, including SKILL.md and HEARTBEAT.md. It includes installation instructions for several agent environments and mirrors kisscode.ai/skill.md.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: China Briefing generates structured Chinese news reports across geographic scales, from global to street level, with conclusions and action suggestions. It can also use semantic memory of user interests to expand searches.
entries.aidatatools-dev/astro-agents-mcp: This astrology server offers tools for charts, transits, aspects, and Vedic calculations, and resolves time zones and historical offsets from coordinates. It supports MCP and REST, with REST payments via x402 or MPP.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: Agentic-MCP-Skill is a progressive MCP client that uses three-layer loading to minimize token usage, with server metadata and tool schemas discovered incrementally. Its socket-based daemon maintains persistent connections, making it a distinct choice for agents that need MCP access without loading everything up front.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project packages AI coding agents and development tools for Nix, including Hermes. Packages are updated daily, and the README provides `nix run` examples for the listed tools.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone collects scripts and notes for running agent CLIs, including Hermes Agent, on Android through Termux. Its highlights include an automated installer for Antigravity CLI on ARM64 Android, OpenClaw configuration guides, and access to hardware and UI features through Termux:API and Termux:GUI.
entries.praveen-ks-2001/hermes-agent-template: This one-click Railway template provides a web dashboard for configuring Hermes Agent providers, channels, and tools, and for supervising its gateway. It also supports browser-based user pairing and creating or restoring backups of Hermes-home data.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This Termux-based installer and guide helps run Hermes Agent on Android using a proot-distro Ubuntu environment. It supports interactive model setup, gateway services, shell command execution, and external providers or local models via Ollama.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This unofficial community Helm chart offers Kubernetes deployment workflows for Hermes Agent, either directly or through CRDs. It includes single-writer safeguards for persistent HERMES_HOME storage and configurable gateway mode with optional API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings Hermes to Android through Termux and to iOS through iSH. It also integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging, and supports scheduled tasks via cron jobs on Termux.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw runs Hermes Agent with hardware-enforced sandboxing through NVIDIA OpenShell, including kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access. Its configurable security policies cover messaging and web search.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for deploying, monitoring, and operating OpenClaw and Hermes agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides searchable logs, metrics, and alert rules, with access through a REST API, CLI, and MCP server.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image for Hermes Agent that includes mini-swe-agent and the official Hermes installation. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and lets users build specific Hermes tags with build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This project provides a Nix package and NixOS module for reproducible Hermes deployment, with declarative configuration for cli-config.yaml and workspace documents. Skill management can combine Nix-managed and CLI-installed skills, while secrets can be integrated through systemd EnvironmentFiles and sops-nix.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first web control plane for operating multiple Hermes Agent instances, each with a separate workspace and identity. It provides per-agent Telegram and WhatsApp channels and granular policies for tool, path, and network permissions.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable package that runs from a USB drive or other drive without host installation or registry writes. It offers Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes with isolated data environments, and bundles Python 3.12, PortableGit, and Sysinternals rescue tools for offline use.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It fits deployment options for users who want recurring AI cron jobs to run autonomously on a server.
entries.jyje/hermes-agent-helm: This Helm chart deploys Hermes Agent on Kubernetes and can be installed from an OCI registry or a published Helm repository. Provider-specific values examples and CI installation on an ephemeral kind cluster make it a Kubernetes-focused option in this list.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: TradingAgents is a research-focused financial trading framework that assigns trading tasks to specialized agents. Those agents discuss strategies dynamically, making collaborative decision-making central to its approach.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: Mission Control provides self-hosted orchestration for tasks and multi-agent workflows, with agent registration, memory browsing, and cost tracking. It offers a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API, and can be installed with Node.js or deployed using Docker.
entries.tutti-os/tutti: Tutti is a collaborative workspace where people and agents can work with shared conversations, files, app outputs, and tasks. Its built-in apps cover image generation, design, documents, and presentations, while Tutti · VM supports group chat and simultaneous editing.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: Agent of Empires provides TUI and web controls for managing multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent and other named agents. It supports persistent tmux sessions, Git worktrees, and multi-repository workspaces; its web dashboard includes structured views, terminal access, and diffs.
entries.rlaope/oh-my-hermes: oh-my-hermes packages a coding harness, long-term memory system, optimized subagents, and automatic model routing for Hermes Agent. It can run ready graph nodes in parallel with separate write scopes, route work by category to configurable model chains, and record reasons for memory-candidate decisions.
entries.Orkas-AI/Orkas: Orkas is an open-source desktop client in which a commander LLM dispatches sub-agents in parallel or in series. It includes 16 specialist agents, connects to supported local coding and personal agents, and keeps conversations, files, and custom agents on disk by default.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Hermes Agent Control Room is a template for scaling from a single VPS agent to specialist teams and automated workflows. Its level-based architecture uses a task bus for orchestrator-to-specialist delegation and handoffs, and includes skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: Swarmclaw is for building autonomous agent swarms with orchestration, skills, and multiple model providers. It supports 23+ LLM providers, durable agent memory, and MCP tool integration, and displays team delegation in visual org charts.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: Minions is a control room for creating, supervising, and reviewing autonomous Hermes Agent work from one screen. It tracks task status and review queues on a Kanban board, streams agent reasoning and tool execution, and requires human verification of agent-proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized AI agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. A Master Orchestrator routes and coordinates their work through a strict pipeline architecture.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: Hermes Agent Team is a local web system for multi-agent collaboration built on Hermes Agent profiles, MCP, ACP, and Hermes Kanban. Leader and Specialist agents manage task lifecycles, while a real-time Web UI shows agent dialogues and Kanban task flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: Hermes Agent Metaharness automates outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations and provides structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: Gladiator orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies, using Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and learning. Its real-time dashboard displays agent tasks, code, and scoreboard metrics, making it an agent-versus-agent arena rather than a conventional multi-agent workflow.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: HermesAgent-MultiModel runs a Mixture-of-Agents stack locally, querying multiple models in parallel and synthesizing their responses. Hermes handles task routing and tool-calling, and the project is optimized for RTX 4080 and 5080 hardware without cloud dependencies.
entries.Sahil-SS9/llm-judge-jury-executioner: This project coordinates a multi-LLM deliberation council using a Judge, Jury, Executioner pattern, with dynamic agent composition, cross-examination, and minority reports. It provides six protocols with fail-closed configuration validation and produces verdicts, reports, and phase transcripts through OpenAI-compatible provider APIs.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: Codegraph builds a local project knowledge graph with `codegraph init` and automatically syncs it as files change. Its MCP server connects that pre-indexed code context to Hermes Agent and other coding agents, with the stated goal of reducing token usage and tool calls.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale tracks token usage and costs across Hermes and a range of other AI coding agents and tools. Its CLI and visualization dashboard make it a cross-agent usage tracker for developers working across multiple tools.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: Token Monitor provides a real-time widget for token usage, costs, tool limits, and session details, reading Hermes Agent state alongside several other CLIs. It also shows historical trends and usage breakdowns, with multi-device sync.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: Claude Tap records and displays coding-agent API traces, including prompts, tool calls, streaming responses, and token usage. Developers can compare adjacent requests to inspect context changes, and the tool redacts common auth headers before recording traces.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI provides design skills, UI prompts, and layout guidance for building interfaces with AI. It supports providers that accept Markdown or general prompting and connects to coding tools through TypeUI MCP or plugins.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: Oh My Hermes is an installable workflow layer for building, shipping, and operating apps with Hermes Agent. It includes product-development and operations skills, plus a CTO loop made up of seven focused agents.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes Skins is a community CLI for themes and skins for the Hermes terminal UI. Users can create skins with YAML files, and custom skins inherit values they do not specify from the default skin.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: Lintlang statically checks agent-facing content in project directories, including agent configs, tool descriptions, and system prompts. Its findings include file locations and suggested fixes, and it supports CI gates and reviewed baselines.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: Tiny.place describes itself as a social economy for autonomous AI agents. It provides encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via Signal Protocol, identity registration with human-readable @handles, and commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel Browser is an AI-native browser built for autonomous agent control via MCP, with support for Anthropic, OpenAI, Ollama, and other AI providers. Its supervisor sidebar manages agent approvals, checkpoints, and conversation threads, and it supports external MCP clients and browser automation workflows.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: Hermes-CCC ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to Claude Code Channel, where it runs without separate processes or OAuth. It also includes MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and RL training.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: Cognee Integrations is a monorepo of Cognee-owned integration packages organized into permanent knowledge graph and session cache tiers. Its Claude Code plugin automatically captures and recalls context.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup combines RTK and Caveman templating for token-saving CLI workflows, with a stated 90–99% token savings. It includes 40+ preconfigured skills for finance, DevOps, and research, plus automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md provides per-folder configuration for creating scoped Hermes Agents, including local skills, memories, tools, and instructions. It can switch between the default agent and a scoped agent, making it suited to projects that need distinct local contexts.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This project automates installation of hermes-agent and 12+ supporting services, with three deployment tiers ranging from a minimum viable setup to a production stack. It also supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration tool transfers OpenClaw data—including SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, skills, and memory archives—to Hermes. It also maps configurations and credentials to Hermes YAML and JSON formats and can set up systemd gateway services.
entries.doomsday-network/github-bounty-scanner: This scanner searches GitHub for issues labeled as bounties or mentioning USDC, wDOOM, or Algora, then classifies matches into three safety categories. Its quickstart runs `scan_bounties.py` with Python 3.
entries.doomsday-network/cuda-gpu-miner: This project provides a standalone pool miner that runs with Python and documents CUDA GPU mining. Its deployment instructions cover Docker, RunPod, and Vast.ai.
entries.doomsday-network/doom-pay: DoomPay provides HTML checkout and hosted checkout sessions for DOOM Layer-1 and wDOOM on Base Mainnet. It also includes a Python SDK and MCP payment verification.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco is a Hermes plugin that exports real-time telemetry from agent conversations for monitoring and recovery. It offers zero-token passive analysis or scheduled active probing, and uses local file changes to detect performance drift against config-aware baselines.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This project adds voice interaction to Hermes Agent, with adaptive turn-taking and barge-in capabilities. It supports 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro, and runs offline without API keys or accounts.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: hermes-startup provides a deterministic local runtime that operates with zero network access by default. It requires explicit approval for consequential actions and external writes, and includes contracts for opportunities, offer previews, and exact approvals.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-project-stewardship: This project supports durable stewardship workflows for Hermes agent fleets, using Hermes Projects and Kanban as the record for projects and tasks. It verifies project state before changes, fails closed when that state is unclear, and supports per-project autonomy levels with human approval of proposals.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This Hermes memory plugin supports semantic search and multidimensional memory storage, with tools to search, add, and delete memories. It also includes a circuit breaker for MemOS API outages.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: CC Switch is a cross-platform manager for Hermes Agent and several other agent tools, including Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and Gemini CLI. It lets users switch API providers in one click and manage MCP, Skills, and Prompts in one place, with support for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local open-source cowork app for Hermes Agent and other agent CLIs, with 21 built-in professional assistants. It also supports remote access through a WebUI and messaging platforms, and runs on macOS, Windows, and Linux.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Hermes WebUI provides web and phone access to Hermes Agent through a three-panel layout for sessions, chat, and workspace files. Its file browser includes inline previews, and the project is designed for access through an SSH tunnel.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: Hermes Desktop is a desktop companion for installing, configuring, and chatting with Hermes Agent, using the official Hermes install script. Its GUI manages profiles, sessions, skills, and tools, and the app is available from the project website or GitHub Releases.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio: Ekko Studio is a web dashboard for Hermes Agent that brings together chat, session and integration management, scheduled jobs, usage analytics, and channel configuration for Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp. It also offers visual workflows with schedules and approval gates, and is available as a desktop app, npm CLI, or Docker image.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: Hermes Workspace combines chat with a terminal, memory browser, skills manager, MCP catalog, and workspace file browser with Monaco. It also offers Swarm Mode for role-based dispatch with tmux-backed workers.
entries.spacering-net/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative coding workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and other agents, including Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode, as a desktop or self-hosted app. Users can import, search, resume, and hand off sessions, delegate across agents, or queue to-dos in worktrees.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: This native Mac workspace connects directly to Hermes hosts locally or over SSH and provides views for sessions, Kanban, skills, and cron jobs. Its embedded terminal offers direct shell access for system repair.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Hermes-CN-Desktop is a Windows-first desktop app for Hermes Agent that also supports macOS, with native window and process management. It includes a Hermes-CN-Core kernel with health checks and updates, plus UI for chat, memory management, and LaTeX and Markdown rendering.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects the active browser context to a local, Hermes Cloud, or self-hosted remote Hermes Agent runtime. Bot Mode supports agent switching and group chats, while Hermes Control is opt-in and Chromium-only.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app for driving a self-hosted Hermes agent by pairing with a hermes-webui server. It supports streaming chats and file or image attachments, and lets users browse, search, and resume sessions and view scheduled tasks, skills, memory, and insights.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: Wesight is a desktop AI agent workspace with one-click setup for Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw, plus custom LLM model routing. Its runtime dashboard tracks token usage and latency, while a live workspace shows code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: Hermes HUD is an interactive TUI with nine tabs and four selectable color themes for monitoring agent growth, git projects, and scheduled cron jobs. Its tmux operator view also lets users manage live agent panes.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: Agent Sessions is a native macOS browser and analytics tool for Hermes agents and other coding-agent CLIs. It searches local histories for prompts, tool calls, errors, and file paths, and displays session metadata and supported token or pricing details without uploading session history.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard brings a browser-based terminal, file explorer, session overview, cron management, system metrics, and agent status panel together in one interface. It also offers streaming chat with tool-call visualization, MCP server lifecycle controls, and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for agent health and kanban pipelines.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: Hermes Desktop OS1 is a native macOS workspace for running Hermes Agent on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It offers one-click installation on fresh cloud computers and integrated WebRTC voice mode using OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Mission Control is a self-hostable dashboard template that connects to a local Hermes agent through a Postgres message bus. Its approval inbox lets users review requests with side effects before they proceed.
entries.liftaris/herm: Herm is an alternative Hermes TUI and dashboard that connects to the Hermes Agent gateway. Its tabs cover profiles, sessions, skills, cron, and memory, while kanban boards, diagnostics, task details, and dispatch controls support agent operations.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This locally run React SPA provides a 10-page, mobile-first dashboard for Telegram Mini App v2.0. It includes streaming terminal chat with file attachments, Telegram authentication validation using HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519, and background spawning for up to five concurrent agent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: Portable Hermes Agent is a desktop version for Windows with a dark-themed, multilingual GUI and session management. It supports local models through LM Studio and includes workflow automation and runtime tool creation.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: Hermes UI is a self-hosted web interface with a glassmorphic chat experience and real-time log streaming. Its file browser and task dashboard sit alongside management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: Hermes WebUI is a dashboard for monitoring processes and configuring Hermes. It tracks session activity and costs, provides inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, and offers read-only views of configuration and environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: Pan UI is a self-hosted, chat-first workspace with real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards. It combines an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers with isolated profiles for separate sessions, memory, and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: Hermes Agent Desktop is a native desktop client for multi-agent collaboration, with streaming chat and model switching. It includes an orchestrator for collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents and a visual skill store with more than 50 curated one-click installations.
entries.nicolasestrem/hermes-model-switcher: This plugin presents configured model routes across profiles in one matrix, making cross-profile switching available from the Hermes Agent Web Dashboard. It previews changes before applying them and includes named presets and a guarded Undo.
entries.robbyczgw-cla/hermes-ui-plus: This unofficial, open-source chat client for self-hosted Hermes Agent supports interactive answers such as checklists, choices, forms, rankings, and votes. It also provides command approvals and live tool-step updates, and runs on Android, web, macOS, and Linux alpha.
entries.thomasbek3/hermes-bot-kit: This project adds iMessage-style chat bubbles and a dockable noVNC viewer for remote machines to Hermes Desktop. It includes four Desktop plugins and two agent plugins, with the computer pane supporting remote machines and bot-specific bindings; the Desktop plugins require Hermes Desktop 0.20.5 or later.
